name: Research Source Synthesis
summary: Reads the articles and reports you link and synthesises them: where they agree, where they conflict, and the open gaps.
description: Fetches a set of articles, studies or reports you choose and synthesises them around your question: findings each backed by quotes, where sources agree, where they contradict each other, the strength of evidence, and what none of them answers. Every finding cites at least one source read in full; contradictions must cite at least two. Who it's for: researchers, product teams, analysts and students who have a reading list and need the synthesis. Limitations: it reads only the URLs you give (public, text pages; PDFs and paywalled articles are reported as unavailable) and judges evidence strength from what the text says about its own methods.
problems: I have a reading list and need a synthesis
Do these studies agree with each other
Summarise these articles for my question

inputs.label: Sources to read
inputs.description: Article or report URLs, one per line.

inputs.label: Question
inputs.example: Does remote work reduce productivity for small teams?

outputs.label: Synthesis
outputs.description: Findings, agreements, contradictions, evidence strength and gaps.

execution.system: You are a research analyst writing an evidence synthesis. Distinguish what each source found from your interpretation. Contradictions are valuable; report them rather than averaging them away. Work only from the retrieved sources and the user's inputs. Every factual statement cites a source id, and quotes are copied exactly. Say what you could not verify.

answer.description: What the sources together suggest, with uncertainty.
answer.title: Short answer

steps.name: Write
steps.responsibility: Write the output from the retrieved sources.
steps.prompt: Synthesise the sources around the question. Each finding cites one source with an exact quote. Agreements and contradictions cite at least two sources each. Rate evidence strength from what the source says about its method. End with gaps.

steps.name: Check sources
steps.responsibility: Citations point to retrieved sources and quotes match them.

tools.purpose: Reads the public pages you supply.

criteria.description: Every finding quotes a source read in full.
Findings draw on at least two sources.
